description: This file defines security utilities for token creation/verification and password hashing, notably handling JWT tokens and bcrypt password hashing.

methods.name: str hash_password(plain_password: str)
methods.description: Hash a plain text password using bcrypt.

methods.name: bool verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str)
methods.description: Verify a plain text password against a bcrypt hash.

methods.name: str create_access_token( subject: str, secret_key: str, algorithm: str = "HS256", expires_delta: Optional[timedelta] = None, issuer: str = "recipe-hub", audience: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Create a short-lived JWT access token.

methods.name: dict decode_access_token( token: str, secret_key: str, algorithms: list[str] | None = None, issuer: Optional[str] = "recipe-hub", audience: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Decode and validate a JWT token, returning the payload if valid.
